scope: SHA-256 preservation audit of the supplied pre-Phase4 baseline against a point-in-time workspace read; no authorship or production-acceptance claim.

method.baseline_coverage: Every one of the 17,564 baseline paths was checked, including baseline .ruff_cache files.
method.audit_output_exclusion_reason: Avoid recursive self-hashing. The two audit artifacts are authorized new Phase4 evidence.
method.concurrency_limit: Files are hashed over the recorded interval. Stat-before/stat-after and end-of-scan inventory checks detect observed in-scan changes; later edits require a new audit.
method.unchanged_hash_encoding: unchanged_baseline_files records both the baseline and current hash, because those bytes match. Changed entries retain both digests. The full baseline is recoverable from unchanged entries, changed before hashes, and missing entries.
method.ownership_limit: Hash differences establish changed bytes only. Separate non-AM changes are neither attributed nor reverted. Global catalog/README/STATUS surfaces may aggregate multiple authorized streams.

allowed_scope.live_am_documents_and_tools: Current AM implementation plan, support matrix, packaging documentation, capability inventories, registry, and integration tools are mutable. Prior phase evidence and recorded phase implementations remain protected.
allowed_scope.generated_manifest_exception: Research, Banking, and generic owner package manifests may be regenerated; none changed in this snapshot.
